desc:
Kurumi, the dumb android. Chiaki, her guardian with a few screws loose. Sakina, calm, composed, and easily amused. Shiyuki, the only sane(?) girl.

Follow their exciting high school life as they tinker with and pamper Kurumi, as well as talk about nothing in particular.
